Subject: MSA + Order Form: pen-test language and evidence cadence (coordination)

Karthik / Laura —

We got ClearSight's redline packet this morning (see attached OrderForm_CSH-clean.pdf). Key asks from their security team: tighter pen-test notification windows, explicit SOC 2 evidence access SLA, and a request for a 2-week rolling inspection window for privileged inspection. Legal asked me to gather operational answers so they can push back on scope in the MSA security exhibit.

Specific items I want to resolve before Laura & legal send the consolidated reply:
- Pen-test language: "reasonable notice" vs explicit 14-day notice + staging access window. What do we support operationally?
- Evidence cadence: they want weekly evidence deliveries during onboarding and monthly thereafter — is that sustainable?
- SOC 2: they asked for a timely copy of our latest Type II and a commitment to share future reports within 30 days of issuance.

I've attached a working redline of the MSA (Redwood-MSA-redline-v3.docx) with inline notes where legal will need operational confirmation. Also attached an evidence mapping draft (evidence-mapping-v2.xlsx).

Quick ask: can you confirm the pen-test notice we can commit to, plus whether we can do the proposed onboarding cadence (weekly artifacts for first 6 weeks) or if we need to propose an alternative (e.g., two checkpoints: onboarding + monthly thereafter)? I'll consolidate and loop in the ClearSight security contact.

Thanks,
Mina
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-MSA-redline-v3.docx (document), evidence-mapping-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), OrderForm_CSH-clean.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: pen-test language and evidence cadence (coordination)

Thanks Mina — helpful summary. Quick notes from infra/serving runtime perspective: 

- Pen-test notice: we can commit to a 14-calendar-day notice for full-system penetration tests that require staging access. For scoped tests (e.g., application-level fuzzing or limited-surface tests) we can accept 7-calendar-day notice. We should preserve the right to require a scoped blast radius and pre-approved test plan.
- Staging access: ephemeral staging creds can be stood up for a 72-hour window once validated by our oncall; we need 1 business-day lead time to provision.
- Evidence cadence: weekly drops for the first 6 weeks is operationally heavy but feasible for high-touch enterprise deals if agreed as a short-term onboarding SLA tied to a success plan (i.e., billing trigger). Otherwise propose: two-weekly check during onboarding (weeks 1 and 3) then monthly artifacts.

I'll mark the MSA redline where we should insert the 14/7-day split and the provisioning constraints. Laura — can you confirm if legal is comfortable with the conditional onboarding SLA (high-touch only) vs universal?

-karthik
Senior Director, Infrastructure

Mina / Karthik —

Laura (legal) here. We should push for concrete language rather than vague terms. Draft suggestions: 

- Pen-test notification: "Customer shall provide written notice no less than fourteen (14) calendar days for tests requiring staging or privileged access; seven (7) calendar days for non-privileged scoped tests."
- Provisioning SLA: add a sentence "Redwood shall use commercially reasonable efforts to provision ephemeral staging access within one (1) business day following Customer's delivery of a test plan."
- Evidence cadence: propose the conditional approach: weekly evidence during a defined onboarding period (explicitly limited to 6 weeks after go-live) for customers who select the onboarding SLA on the Order Form. For others, default to monthly artifact deliveries.

I'll update the redline and send to Mina for external circulation. Also suggest we ask for ClearSight to provide their pen-test plan 72 hours before the scheduled start to allow for safety gating. 

-LB
Associate Counsel, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — appreciate the fast turnaround and the concrete proposals. A few clarifications from ClearSight's side: 

- The 14/7 split is fine. For clarity we will mark whether a test is "privileged/staging" vs "scoped/non-privileged" when we submit the test plan.
- Staging provisioning SLA: 1 business day is reasonable; we can accept provisioning lead time as long as the test plan is submitted. We will aim to provide the test plan 72 hours before the scheduled start.
- Evidence cadence: ClearSight is amenable to the conditional onboarding SLA. For enterprise deals we typically select the high-touch onboarding and would like weekly artifacts for the first 6 weeks; please confirm the list of artifacts (evidence-mapping-v2 had a proposed list but we want to lock it).

Attachments: we've uploaded our SOC 2 Type II (2026) to SecureShare — link: https://secureshare.clearsighthealth.com/SOC2/CSH-SOC2-TypeII-2026.pdf. We will also provide a screenshot of proof-of-scan for the pen-test engagement after completion.

Thanks,
Anjali Rao
